scope_limit: A bounded host-149 native expression workflow now calls actual cached GDC STAR assembly, five-fold TMM, five-fold ssGSEA, native conversions and annotation/detection scope producers. Actual plan/build CLI and downstream native readers were exercised with two synthetic cancer cohorts and forty synthetic raw files. It ends before association analysis, model fitting and publication. Remaining native CNV/graph/comparison/training command consolidation, complete source/patient identity coverage and final C01/C13/C16 acceptance remain open.
